scientific_integrity: A proved all-height Chow-ring classification; finite regression checks are not substituted for the proof. The family and underlying projective-bundle formula are explicitly credited to prior work.
scientific_limitations: Only the threefold n=2 Frobenius-incidence family over algebraically closed fields is classified.
Residue-prime isomorphisms are abstract and need not lift to compatible integral isomorphisms.
Historical priority not independently validated; 1993 unseparated-flags reference not available in full text.
title: Frobenius height is detected by the integral Chow cubic but not by any prime-field reduction
